Every surface after the refinement pass

17 August 2026 · SP-CONSOLE-REFINE complete (phases 1–6) · 31 live captures across the operator console, workspace admin and the public tier · seeded demo, mid-live-day · diffed against the 13 Aug baseline

Branch dev/prog1-p6-2-public-ia: Vite :5173 → host backend :8600; entrant SSR :5175. Gates: vitest 1751, entrant 586, pytest green, contrast 64/64 AA both themes, eslint / tsc / depcruise 0 errors.

Refined this pass (what changed since 13 Aug)

  • Naming — one glossary (docs/design/console-naming.md): Run→“Live day”, “Re-solve meet”→“Re-plan day”, “Links & access”→“Sharing”, module tri-state “Later”→“Available”, “&”→“and”, picker “Commit”→“Save participants/pairs”, en-US throughout.
  • Buttons & decisions — the phase CTA lives in the Overview header; forms save from section headers; “Regenerate from roster” is demoted to outline and warns what a live-day regenerate destroys; lifecycle is display-only with an Archive/Unarchive toggle; the solver chip is silent when idle.
  • Density — a 13px data-row step (--text-2sm), tightened band and header chrome, 32px control heights; the 48px two-line band reservation deliberately stays (row uniformity).
  • MatchCard — one shared archetype across both match lists, both detail panes, the draw tree and the TV board: no ordinals, winner dots, per-set/aggregate score lanes, W.O./Ret. badges, stacked pair members.
  • Admin polish — centered admin column, day-grouped backups with a plain-words restore confirm, module catalog taxonomy + blocked-reasons, display config cross-links and scope helper, one lock message per surface.
  • Public tier — discovery facets became instant-apply links (zero JS, aria-current, whole-query hrefs); the date range keeps the GET form.

Deliberate deviations (why the report differs from the directive’s letter)

  • D1.1 standings ink — loss counts shipped in muted ink (owner ruling) rather than the directive’s exact treatment; wins carry the emphasis.
  • D19 meet sets — meet set scores are not persisted server-side (match_states has no sets column), so the meet per-set lane is session-only; the aggregate persists and renders. Bracket persists fully. A migration is out of program scope; logged in the debt log.
  • B2.2 — already satisfied by the shipped surface before this pass; no change made.
  • “Lock draw” — the picker button became “Save participants”/“Save pairs”, not the directive’s “Lock draw”: the action only upserts the participant list — row-level Generate is what creates the draw, so “Lock draw” would have lied.
  • StaleBanner “Re-solve” — left as-is on the meet-only surface; it composes with “Re-plan day” rather than colliding with it.
  • “Commit” elsewhere — EntriesDesk’s “Commit to roster” and the director proposal modal’s “Commit” stay: both commit staged work to a target, which is what the word means; the rename targeted the draw picker only.
  • P2.1 event times stay UTC-labeled — viewer-local time needs JS (banned on the tier, CSP + weight gate) and venue-local needs a timezone the data model doesn’t record; <time> does not localize display without script. Schema change = out of program scope.
  • A4.1 middot — capability lines join with “·”, not the directive’s em-dash examples: the emDashContract bans U+2014 in rendered copy.
  • Contrast floor — carried from the 13 Aug pass: solid status fills sit one shade deeper than the mock’s (its white-on-#16A34A fails WCAG 4.5:1); live cards show elapsed/late time, not invented live scores.
